141-2921-4454.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2921-4454.description:
Cast Bond of Revival by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Bond of Revival.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Bond of Revival
Resolve the Bond of Revival copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

465-585-1849-3742-4251.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Phantom Steed to become a Samurai until end of turn.
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping it and all Samurai you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

465-5987-6495.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 3.
465-5987-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3234-3293-3899-5413.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-3899-5413.description:
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-3899-5413.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

2770-5571-6495--6.description:
Use Donate to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 2.
2770-5571-6495--6.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1170-2829-4908-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2829-4908-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Enthusiastic Mechanaut.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager
Repeat.

1742-5078-6918.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1169-3259-7796.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1169-3259-7796.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Precinct Captain, triggering Breath of Fury and Precinct Captain.
Resolve the Precinct Captain trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

661-3685-4659-7693.easyPrerequisites: Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
661-3685-4659-7693.description:
Cast Sculpting Steel by paying {2} due to Armor Wars. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Spine of Ish Sah.
When Sculpting Steel enters, its first ability triggers, destroying a permanent.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sculpting Steel, adding {C}{C}.
Sculpting Steel's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1753-3259-7603.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that has base power 0.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1753-3259-7603.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Primo.
Resolve the Primo trigger, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the damage dealt.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Fractal token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

uses.exileCardState: exiled by Steward of the Harvest

1556-5200-6474.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

7-1477-4907-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-1477-4907-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Hamza. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

3713-5078-6723-6918.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

2292-3703-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Sporemound triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

957-5626-6927.manaNeeded: {8}{U}{U} the first turn, with {10}{U}{U}{B}{B} each second extra turn
957-5626-6927.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with mana value 2 or less.
You have at least {E}
957-5626-6927.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value 2 or less, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Damage Control Crew from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Damage Control Crew enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}, sacrificing Damage Control Crew, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

339-413-677-3499.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Jegantha enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

3057-3609-6750.notablePrerequisites:
Bloodthirster cannot be blocked by an opponent.
Inspirit has one or more charge counters on it.
3057-3609-6750.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Inspirit triggers, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Bloodthirster, triggering its ability, causing you to untap it and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your second combat phase. At the beginning of the combat phase, Inspirit triggers, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

252-413-4871.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

4775-5231-6553.easyPrerequisites: Necrogen Communion attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
4775-5231-6553.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Repeat.

2034-2178-3362-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken Dragon with mana value 6.
2034-2178-3362-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken Dragon with mana value 6.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the Dragon with mana value 6 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Bladewing.
When Bladewing dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Repeat.

2157-2598-4110.easyPrerequisites: You have not copied a spell using The Sixth Doctor this turn.
2157-2598-4110.description:
Cast Gideon by paying {4}{W}.
The Sixth Doctor triggers, copying the Gideon spell, with the copy being nonlegendary.
Resolve both Gideon spells.
Activate a mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Romana II by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Gideon token.
Activate a Gideon token's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 4.

1494-2230-5087-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six other cards in your graveyard.
1494-2230-5087-5256.description:
Cast Polukranos Unchained from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {4}{B}{G} and exiling six other cards from your graveyard, causing it to enter the battlefield with twelve +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Polukranos Unchained.
When Polukranos Unchained dies, The Ozolith's first ability triggers, putting twelve +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to Polukranos Unchained's power.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith's second ability triggers, moving the +1/+1 counters from it onto Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

1367-2334-4628.notablePrerequisites: Kaho does not have summoning sickness.
1367-2334-4628.description:
Activate Kaho by paying {7} and tapping it, casting Nexus of Fate from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Nexus of Fate, taking an extra turn after this one and shuffling it into your library.
At the beginning of your end step, Soulherder triggers, blinking Kaho.
Soulherder triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Kaho enters the battlefield, searching your library for Nexus of Fate and exiling it.
Repeat each turn.
